Water Atlas / Terlingua source library

Start with what is already known.

Reports, public meeting records, utility information and water-use evidence for the Terlingua area. Follow each source to its publisher and check the review notes before drawing conclusions.

Loading the source catalog…

A source catalog is a starting point. Records have different review levels, and some are scanned or unavailable. A funding award is not proof of completed work; historical pumping is not proof of sustainable additional supply. This library links to original records. Only selected water-use reports are bundled here; the full research archive is not included.

Original material remains subject to its publisher’s terms. Source dates, retrieval notes and historical file hashes support verification; they do not imply current availability or independent validation. The project is an independent research effort.

To retrieve a small local selection, run python scripts/download_sources.py from the project directory. It lists records first; add --download to fetch them.
